prompt: a watermleon is $2.99lb, and one watermelon steve wants is 6 pounds. How much will it cost.
response:
To calculate the cost of a 6-pound watermelon when a 1-pound watermelon costs $2.99, you simply multiply the price per pound by the number of pounds:

\[ \text{Cost} = \text{Price per pound} \times \text{Number of pounds} \]

So,

\[ \text{Cost} = 2.99 \times 6 = 17.94 \]

Therefore, a 6-pound watermelon will cost $17.94.
